format: JavaScript (ESM module for SvelteKit server route)
description: This file is a server-side route for handling lead-related operations in a Django + SvelteKit project. It includes functions for loading leads with filtering, creating, updating, deleting, converting, duplicating, moving status, and fetching individual lead details. The code interfaces with external APIs (Django REST API endpoints) and processes lead data between backend responses and frontend models.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously loads leads data based on URL search parameters, with support for pagination, filtering, and view modes (table or kanban). It fetches leads, tags, users, teams, and contacts from APIs, processes hierarchical Django response formats, and returns structured data for the frontend.

methods.name: actions.create
methods.description: Handles creation of a new lead by parsing form data, validating inputs, constructing a lead object, and sending a POST request to the Django API.

methods.name: actions.update
methods.description: Handles updating an existing lead identified by leadId. Parses form data, validates, and sends a PATCH request to update the lead.

methods.name: actions.delete
methods.description: Deletes a lead specified by leadId via API DELETE request.

methods.name: actions.convert
methods.description: Marks a lead as converted by changing its status to 'converted' via PATCH request.

methods.name: actions.duplicate
methods.description: Creates a copy of an existing lead, fetching its data and posting a new lead with similar fields, with a new title indicating duplication.

methods.name: actions.updateStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a lead, typically used in kanban view drag-and-drop, via PATCH request to move status.

methods.name: actions.getLead
methods.description: Fetches full details of a single lead, transforming API response into frontend-compatible format.
